title: The Wild Wolf Revisited
author: Theo Joubert
blurb: Coral Blackwood, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
